findings.text: the reviewed node's manifest declares no tests, test_logs, baseline_suite or after_suite field, so the gate pair the done_when names is readable only from files under logs/ and not from the record a reader consumes

the population arm's command header carries an unsubstituted placeholder, `$(cat logs/importing-tests.txt where logs is the run log directory)`, instead of the literal command, so the measurement establishing no added failure cannot be re-run from the log; the chunked runs record the same shape, `<files in logs/chunks/chunkNN.txt>`
